Order 18/08/2023

The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.c. has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of cognizance order in F.R. No.146/2013 dated 21.06.2016 pending before Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Raisinghnagar, District Sriganganagar and quashing of criminal proceedings for offences under Sections 420 & 120B of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has already been compromised between the parties which is borne [2023:RJ-JD:26148] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-4824/2023] out from the compromise deed that the respondent No.2- complainant is not inclined to proceed further in the matter.

Counsel has placed reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs.
State of Punjab & Anr. [(2012) 10 SCC 303].

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the complainant concurs the fact of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, he does not want to proceed further in the matter.

In view of compromise arrived at between the parties and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed and the F.R. No. 146/2013 dated 21.06.2016 pending before learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Raisinghnagar, District Sriganganagar and all criminal proceedings for offences under Sections 420 & 120B of IPC lodged against qua the petitioners are hereby quashed on the basis of compromise deed.
Stay petition also decided accordingly.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 316-raksha/-
